summary: Ready for production. Estimated screen time is about 58 seconds against a 60-second target. Two minor points: decide whether the ferryman is ever seen, and keep the cabin window free of readable reflections.

issues.explanation: The ferryman is only heard. If he is ever seen later he needs a character asset; as written he only needs a voice.
issues.suggestion: Keep him off screen, or add one brief shot of him at the gangway.

issues.quote: Through the window, the pier lights slide away.
issues.explanation: Moving lights seen through glass with the cabin reflected in it can flicker or double in generated video.
issues.suggestion: Frame the window so the pier lights are seen directly, with the reflection kept faint.
